def Roth.mainCoeffBound : (δ : Real) → (q₁ r₁ : Nat) → Nat :=
fun (δ : Real) (q₁ r₁ : Nat) ↦
  @Nat.floor.{0} Real Real.semiring Real.partialOrder
    (@FloorRing.toFloorSemiring.{0} Real Real.instRing Real.linearOrder Real.instFloorRing)
    (@HPow.hPow.{0, 0, 0} Real Real Real (@instHPow.{0, 0} Real Real Real.instPow)
      (@Nat.cast.{0} Real Real.instNatCast q₁)
      (@HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} Real Real Real (@instHMul.{0} Real Real.instMul) δ
        (@Nat.cast.{0} Real Real.instNatCast r₁)))
